answer.reason: The verses tell two notable things Obadiah did: hiding the LORD's prophets and bringing Ahab word of Elijah.

clauses.english: hid a hundred prophets of the LORD in a cave and fed them during Jezebel's purge
clauses.quote: Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave

clauses.english: met Elijah and went to tell Ahab that he had come
clauses.quote: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him

doubts: The 2CH 17:7 Obadiah, sent by Jehoshaphat to teach, is a namesake; no verses about him were given, so he is not covered.
